about: Get a registration (ownership) card so a vehicle can be driven in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: Light vehicle: 400 AED, private or public
Over 3 and up to 12 tonnes: 500 AED private, 750 AED public
Over 12 tonnes: 900 AED private, 1,200 AED public
Light machinery: 600 AED private, 800 AED public
Heavy machinery: 1,000 AED private, 1,300 AED public
Trailer or semi-trailer: 120 AED private, 220 AED public (each year)
Bus of 14 to 26 passengers: 500 AED private, 600 AED public
Bus of more than 26 passengers: 1,200 AED private, 1,000 AED public
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
an Integrated Transport Center service centre
